evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 日天琳宇
evidence.excerpt_zh: 彚芳書院之南為日天琳宇西前樓下之正宇也其制有中前樓中後樓上下各七楹有西前樓西後樓上下各七楹前後樓間穿堂各三楹中前樓南有天橋與樓相屬天橋東南重簷八方者為燈亭西前樓南為東轉角樓又西稍南為西轉角樓中前樓之東垣内八方亭為楞嚴壇又東別院為瑞應宫前為仁應殿中為和感殿後為晏安殿（圓明園册）臣等謹按日天琳宇四十景之一額為皇上御書其規制皆仿雍和宫後佛樓式中前樓上奉闗帝世宗御書額曰極樂世界皇上御書額曰赫聲濯靈聨曰千載丹心扶大義兩間正氣䕶皇圖西前樓上奉玉皇大帝世宗御書額曰一天喜色皇上御書額曰總持元化聨曰地載無私宏槖鑰乾元資始肇綱維此外凡樓宇上下皆供佛像及諸神位瑞應宫諸殿皆祀龍神
evidence.summary: South of 彚芳書院, a temple group copied from the rear Buddha tower of 雍和宫 Yonghe Gong: paired front and rear towers of seven bays on two floors joined by passages, a 'sky bridge', an octagonal double-eaved lantern pavilion, 楞嚴壇, and 瑞應宫 with three halls to the dragon gods. Guandi and the Jade Emperor occupy the upper floors.

evidence.title: Scene 19, 日天琳宇 Ritian Linyu
evidence.excerpt_other: Two-story buildings, connected by a bridge at the level of the second floor, and another bridge running out to a high rockery distinguished this temple.
evidence.summary: A Buddhist temple of two-storey buildings linked by a bridge at second-floor level, and a second bridge out to a high rockery.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
